mapper.sql: select w.id, w.supplier_name as unit_name, concat('供应商提现申请-', w.withdraw_no) as project_name, date_format(coalesce(w.apply_time, w.create_time), '%Y-%m') as settlement_cycle, case when w.status = '3' then '2' when w.status in ('2', '4') then '1' else '0' end as status, w.apply_amount as settlement_amount, w.withdraw_no, w.supplier_name, w.supplier_id, w.apply_amount, w.apply_time, 0 as tax_amount, case when w.status = '3' then w.apply_amount else 0 end as paid_amount, case when w.status = '3' then 0 else w.apply_amount end as unpaid_amount, ff.dept_id as dept_id, w.create_by, w.create_time, w.update_by, w.update_time, coalesce(w.audit_remark, w.remark) as remark, w.del_flag from xfpt_withdraw_apply w left join xfpt_finance_flow ff on ff.id = w.finance_flow_id
mapper.select: order by coalesce(w.apply_time, w.create_time) desc, w.id desc

select coalesce(sum(w.apply_amount), 0) as settlement_amount, 0 as tax_amount, coalesce(sum(case when w.status = '3' then w.apply_amount else 0 end), 0) as paid_amount, coalesce(sum(case when w.status = '3' then 0 else w.apply_amount end), 0) as unpaid_amount, count(1) as total_count, sum(case when w.status not in ('2', '3', '4') then 1 else 0 end) as pending_count, sum(case when w.status in ('2', '4') then 1 else 0 end) as partial_count, sum(case when w.status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as settled_count from xfpt_withdraw_apply w left join xfpt_finance_flow ff on ff.id = w.finance_flow_id
